name: blog-grid

frames.best_why: Shows the full heading, subtitle, divider and two complete rows of cover-image article cards.

tagline: Three-column journal grid whose cover photos zoom and light up under the cursor.
summary: A blog listing with a heading, subtitle and thin divider above a grid of article cards. Each card pairs a wide cover photo with author, date, read time, title and a short excerpt.
appearance: A near-black page holds a left-aligned heading, a one-line subtitle and a hairline divider. Below, three columns of borderless cards show a 16:9 photo over a small meta row, a two-line title and a grey excerpt.
behaviour: Cover images fade in as they enter the viewport, then scale up slightly while a card is hovered, which also tints the card background and brightens its meta row.
demo_content: Titles like 'Design Systems That Scale', bylines Ava Mitchell and Liam Carter, and landscape cover photos.
search_phrases: three column blog cards with photos
article grid with author and read time
journal section for a design blog
blog posts that zoom on hover
latest posts grid with cover images
use_when: A content-heavy page needs a tidy multi-column index of articles, each previewed by a wide photo.
avoid_when: Article data is hardcoded in the file, so wiring a CMS or blog feed means editing the source.
customise: Every article is written into the component's own array, so changing copy, photos or links means editing the source; layout classes and colour tokens follow the surrounding theme.
weight_why: Twelve static cards; the only work is a CSS image scale and a one-time in-view check.

a11y.note: Cards are links, but the hover zoom and tint are mouse-only with no focus styles, and there is no reduced-motion check.

polish_why: Tidy dark grid with clean type and a pleasant hover, but it is a conventional card listing.
